photos.summary: Loaf 1 crumb shot — cut cross-section on white cutting board with purple bread knife, open irregular crumb structure with medium alveoli. Background shows loaf 2 whole on copper cooling rack (cross score visible) and a paper-sleeved gift loaf on the counter.

photos.name: img-8177
photos.summary: Loaf 2 hero shot on copper cooling rack — big domed loaf with cross-score pattern, prominent ear along the deeper diagonal, thick well-browned crust with visible spring, floury dust. Corner of another loaf peeking bottom-left.
